FOOD FOR LIFE

A little kindness
in every meal.

We believe a good meal can nourish more than your appetite.

Part of Perth’s Hare Krishna community, Govinda’s brings the spirit of care and generosity to the table. Our food is rooted in Indian vegetarian cooking and a simple idea: food is something to be shared with love.

Whether you’re here for your usual lunch, exploring vegetarian food, or just passing through Northbridge, there’s a place for you.

Good food. Kind hearts. Everyone welcome.

GOOD TO KNOW

A few little answers.

Is everything vegetarian?+

Yes. Govinda’s is a vegetarian restaurant with vegan options. Some items, including lassi and some desserts, contain dairy. Ask our team which dishes suit your preferences.

Can I order for delivery?+

Yes. You can order from our Uber Eats menu. Enter your address there to see delivery availability, current prices and estimated times.

Does the menu change?+

Daily curries and availability can vary. The favourites above give you a taste of what we serve. Check the delivery menu or call us for today’s options and in-store prices.

What if I have an allergy or dietary requirement?+

Please speak to the team before ordering so they can check the ingredients in that day’s dishes. You can reach us on +61 8 9227 1684.
